explanation: The theorem relates two library-specific definitions: `NRR.ConvexSubbody.supportFunction` (defined as `sSup ((fun x => ⟪x,u⟫) '' C.body)`) and `NRR.Geometry.ConvexBody.supportFunction`, using the library's own unfolding lemmas `ConvexSubbody.supportFunction_eq_sSup` and `Geometry.ConvexBody.supportFunction_eq_sSup`. Mathlib (and Batteries/Lean core) has no notion of a support function: grepping for `supportFunction`, `def supportFunction`, `supportFunction_eq_sSup`, and for `sSup` applied to inner-product images over `Mathlib/Geometry` and elsewhere yields no declaration at all, let alone a statement equating two support functions on a common carrier. The closest result, `NRR.Geometry.ConvexBody.supportFunction_congr`, is a declaration of this library (not Mathlib), and even so it only covers two `Geometry.ConvexBody`s; the content here resides entirely in the library's own definitions/unfolding lemmas, so there is no Mathlib declaration to duplicate or specialize.
